abilities.name: clear-body
abilities.effect: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.

abilities.name: liquid-ooze
abilities.effect: Damages opponents using leeching moves for as much as they would heal.

abilities.name: rain-dish
abilities.effect: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during rain.

kanto.flavorText: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by their stingers.

original-johto.flavorText: As it floats along on the waves, it uses its toxic feelers to stab anything it touches.

hoenn.flavorText: Its body is almost entirely composed of water. It ensnares its foe with its two long tentacles, then stabs with the poison stingers at their tips.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It drifts in sea currents. Countless fishermen are hurt by its poison stingers.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.

updated-johto.flavorText: It drifts aimlessly in waves. Very difficult to see in water, it may not be noticed until it stings.

original-unova.flavorText: Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.

updated-unova.flavorText: Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.

kalos.flavorText: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by their stingers.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Tentacool absorbs sunlight and refracts it using water inside its body to convert it into beam energy. This Pokémon shoots beams from the small round organ above its eyes.

original-alola.flavorText: It drifts in shallow seas, such as the areas near beaches. If you get bitten or stabbed by its toxic tentacles, rush to the hospital.

updated-alola.flavorText: Its body is 99% water. The remaining 1% contains the organ that makes its poison.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: It can sometimes be found all dry and shriveled up on a beach. Toss it back into the sea to revive it.

swsh.flavorText: This Pokémon is mostly made of water. A Tentacool out in the ocean is very hard to spot, because its body blends in with the sea.

pla.flavorText: They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas. During low tide, they can sometimes be found on beaches, desiccated.
